notes.title: Release 4.0.0 Changelog
notes.notes:
NOTE: Mods will currently be disabled in multiplayer for security reasons

+ added multiplayer
+ mod scoring system
+ rewrote mod loader
* input boxes no longer resize
* backend cleanup
* fix debug console
* fix linux builds
* fix upload mod button
* fix modal window input
* fix onload never running
* Allow mod updates
* scoring system rewrite
* the buy next button now costs 1.5x the previous if score is blank
* seeds are now loaded with a save
* rewrote rng, all seeds are changed to 3.0.0 now
+ mods now have fairness
* mods store a sha256 to detect changes
* redesign main menu

notes.title: Join the beta for the upcoming HUGE 4.0.0 Update
notes.notes:
I am now opening a beta for the 4.0.0 update to the public, this update will mostly be bug patches, but will also include a full tutorial and a tool tip system for mods. Along with this you will also now be able to upload to the workshop again as I have finally tested and improved the upload code.

To join the beta, go into game properties > betas and enter the password "LetsGoGetTheBeta"

notes.title: 3.0.0 - Initial Steam Release
notes.notes:
I just want to start off by thanking everyone who has kept me on track for this monuments release, without you this game would still probably still be an itch exclusive, with no level editor and so on.

While this is the initial release, I will still be working on IP non-stop to implement a better help system as the major downfall to IP is currently the rough learning curve for both modding and game play.
